decisions.story_title: CISA adds exploited Apache Roller, Cisco Expressway, SAP NetWeaver and VMware vCenter flaws to KEV
decisions.reason: Nov 20 CISA KEV batch covering four actively exploited enterprise flaws, a distinct advisory roundup from the individual product stories and the earlier Nov 18 KEV batch.

CVE-2026-129448.evidence: CISA added the Apache Roller untrusted-deserialization flaw CVE-2026-129448 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on Nov 20, citing evidence of active exploitation.
